# Veriqo

Veriqo is a kitchen management app for private chefs and mobile caterers in the UK — HACCP food safety records, bookings and menus, and job costing in one place.

- Homepage: https://getveriqo.co.uk
- App: https://getveriqo.co.uk/app
- Operated by: Side Order Catering
- Contact: hello@getveriqo.co.uk

## Modules

Veriqo is one app made up of four connected modules, sharing a single dish library and job record:

### HACCP — https://getveriqo.co.uk/haccp
Digital food safety records to meet UK food hygiene law. Fridge and freezer temperature logs, cooking/cooling/reheating records, delivery and transport temperature logs, cleaning and disinfection records, opening and closing checklists, allergen declarations, pest control logs, staff illness and injury records, staff credentials and certificate tracking with 90-day expiry warnings, approved supplier register. EHO-ready PDF exports.

### Menus — https://getveriqo.co.uk/menus
Booking and menu management. Job and client records, dish library (name, course, description, allergens, prep tasks), client dietary and allergen tracking, job notes and transport log. Shared dish library feeds HACCP, Costing, and Prep Lists.

### Costing — https://getveriqo.co.uk/costing
Job costing, quotes and invoices. Ingredient costing per dish, margin calculator, professional quote generation, invoicing from completed jobs, job profitability tracking, ingredient yield tracking.

### Prep Lists — https://getveriqo.co.uk/prep-lists
Auto-generated prep lists from the Menus dish library, split into prep-ahead and finishing tasks, grouped by course, tickable from a phone in the kitchen. Works offline.

## Pricing

- **Starter — £7/month**: HACCP module only (food safety records, allergen records, EHO-ready exports).
- **Pro — £15/month**: Everything in Starter, plus Menus, Costing, and Prep Lists, with data shared across all modules.
- 14-day free trial, no credit card required, cancel any time.

Veriqo is designed to meet the record-keeping requirements of the UK Food Safety Act 1990 and the Food Standards Agency's Safer Food Better Business guidance for caterers.

## Guides

Practical articles for private chefs at https://getveriqo.co.uk/resources, covering HACCP compliance, EHO inspections, allergen management, food business registration, and pricing.

Veriqo is installable as a Progressive Web App (PWA) on iPhone and Android.
